plan: [I will bid high (49) to win: in a 3-bidder, third-price auction the winner pays the lowest bid, typically well below my value ($37). Bidding 49 maximizes chance to win when payment < value given no history. ]
[Equilibrium bid: in symmetric third-price (3 bidders), best-response is bid = 2*v up to the cap. With v=44, 2*v=88>49, so bid the maximum 49 to maximize expected surplus.]

[Assume Andy and Betty bid their values (uniform). Maximize expected profit: choose b to maximize (b/49)^2*(18 - b/3). First-order optimum gives b = 2v = 36. Bid 36 to maximize expected long-run profit under this model.]
